VettID asks the account service once more. If it still says that your account has no vault, VettID forgets its keys for that vault on this phone and goes back to the start, where you can set up a new vault with a setup code.\n\nOnly do this if you deleted your vault or closed your account. If the vault still exists, this phone could afterwards get back into it only with a recovery.

Everything VettID keeps on this phone is erased, including its keys for your vault, and VettID goes back to the start. Your vault itself is not changed.\n\nTo get back into it you then need a recovery from the account site (it takes 24 hours and needs your PIN and credential password, and the credential backup must be on), or a move from another phone that still holds your vault.
VettID\'s settings on this phone could not be read and were reset: the theme, the app lock (now off) and notifications. Your vault is not affected.
